name: Quality Check

on: [pull_request]

jobs:
  quality:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    services:
      pypi_wayback:
        image: ghcr.io/waleko/pypi-wayback
        ports:
          - 8629:8080
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v3.1.0
    - name: Set up Python 3.8
      uses: actions/setup-python@v3
      with:
        python-version: 3.8

      run: make quality
    - name: Show fix suggestions
      if: ${{ failure() }}
      run: |
        echo "## Quality check failed" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
        echo "" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
        echo "The following issues were found:" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
        echo "" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
        echo '```' >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
        ruff tests src examples benchmarks utils --format=github || true
        echo '```' >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
        echo "" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
        echo "To fix these issues locally, run:" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
        echo '```bash' >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
        echo "pip install -e .[quality]" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
        echo "make style  # This will auto-fix formatting issues" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
        echo "make quality  # Verify all checks pass" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
        echo '```' >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
        exit 1
